name: @red-cup-engineering/csv-stream-triage-service
description: Streams a large CSV (a URL or a file) once, applies column filters and a future-deadline test given as a data record, and writes a dated triage record of what matched. Memory use does not grow with file size.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
